fasting.description: The Bahá'í Fast lasts 19 days. Bahá'ís abstain from food and drink from sunrise to sunset.

about.title: Bahá'í Calendar
about.description1: The Badí' (Bahá'í) calendar was created by the Báb and adopted by Bahá'u'lláh. It consists of 19 months of 19 days each, with 4 or 5 intercalary days (Ayyám-i-Há) before the last month.
about.description2: The Bahá'í year begins on Naw-Rúz (New Year), which coincides with the vernal equinox (around March 20).
about.description3: This app shows three calendar views — Gregorian, Badí', and mixed — along with holy days, 19-day feasts, and the fasting period.

help.title: Help
help.calendarViewsDesc: Use Settings to switch between Gregorian, Badí' (Bahá'í) or mixed view. Each view shows holy days and feasts.
help.navigationDesc: Use arrows to change month/year. Tap "Today" to return to current date. Open the side menu to access events, fasting, and settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.dataCollectionBody: Bahá'í Calendar does not collect, store, or share any personal information. No user account is required.
privacy.localStorageBody: Your preferences (language, theme, calendar view) are saved locally on your device using localStorage. This data never leaves your device.
privacy.apiBody: The app connects to a Bahá'í date API solely to calculate calendar dates and holy days. No personal data is sent in these requests.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: No third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services are used.
privacy.contactBody: For questions about this privacy policy, contact the developer through the App Store listing.

bahaiQuotes.quote1: The earth is but one country, and mankind its citizens.
bahaiQuotes.quote10: Let your vision be world-embracing, rather than confined to your own self.
bahaiQuotes.quote11: Kind words have the power to transform hearts.
bahaiQuotes.quote12: The remedy the world needs is cooperation and reciprocity.
bahaiQuotes.quote13: Serving others is the noblest path to true freedom.
bahaiQuotes.quote14: O son of man! If thine eyes be turned towards justice, choose thou for thy neighbor that which thou choosest for thyself.
bahaiQuotes.quote15: Share generously with thy brother the blessings thou possessest.
bahaiQuotes.quote16: The source of all learning is the knowledge of God.
bahaiQuotes.quote17: Knowledge is one of the greatest benefits of God.
bahaiQuotes.quote18: Hold fast to that which is profitable for you and all mankind.
bahaiQuotes.quote19: Be truthful and sincere in your words.
bahaiQuotes.quote2: So powerful is the light of unity that it can illuminate the whole earth.
bahaiQuotes.quote20: Man must consult in all matters.
bahaiQuotes.quote21: The unity of the human race is the paramount principle of the Bahá'í Faith.
bahaiQuotes.quote22: Love is the light that illuminates every soul.
bahaiQuotes.quote23: Courtesy is the prince of virtues.
bahaiQuotes.quote24: In the garden of thy heart plant naught but the rose of love.
bahaiQuotes.quote25: Justice is the lamp of nations.
bahaiQuotes.quote26: Fill your heart with love and compassion for all humanity.
bahaiQuotes.quote27: Kindness is the greatest gift of God to man.
bahaiQuotes.quote28: Every soul possesses infinite wealth ready to blossom in service.
bahaiQuotes.quote29: The best beloved of all things is justice.
bahaiQuotes.quote3: The purpose of justice is the appearance of unity among men.
bahaiQuotes.quote30: The purpose of religion is to establish unity and concord.
bahaiQuotes.quote31: Blessed is he who preferreth his brother before himself.
bahaiQuotes.quote32: The first principle of the Bahá'í Faith is the independent investigation of truth.
bahaiQuotes.quote33: Let each morn be better than its eve.
bahaiQuotes.quote34: A kindly thought is the charity of the wise.
bahaiQuotes.quote35: True freedom is found in serving others.
bahaiQuotes.quote36: Service to humanity is service to God.
bahaiQuotes.quote37: A pure soul shines with the light of divine love.
bahaiQuotes.quote38: Cultural diversity is a source of pride and beauty.
bahaiQuotes.quote39: Love of country should not blind us to love for all humanity.
bahaiQuotes.quote4: Be generous in prosperity, and thankful in adversity.
bahaiQuotes.quote40: Consultation is a lamp of guidance to direct the path.
bahaiQuotes.quote41: World peace is not only possible but inevitable.
bahaiQuotes.quote42: Deal with all humanity with loyalty and sincerity.
bahaiQuotes.quote43: Humility exalts man to the heaven of glory and power.
bahaiQuotes.quote44: Pure and good thoughts are lamps that illuminate the heart.
bahaiQuotes.quote45: True happiness comes from selfless service to others.
bahaiQuotes.quote5: A kind tongue is the magnet of men's hearts.
bahaiQuotes.quote6: Knowledge is as wings to man's life.
bahaiQuotes.quote7: Work done in the spirit of service is the highest form of worship.
bahaiQuotes.quote8: Your hearts must be pure as crystal.
bahaiQuotes.quote9: Shared joy multiplies the happiness of the world.
